frozen_scope.purpose: Capture venue-native semantic metadata and rules independently for every pair in one sealed PMXT candidate universe.

kalshi.condition: market or event response supplies series_ticker

query.slug: candidate event URL slug or sole nested event slug

raw_evidence.body_semantics: HTTP entity-body bytes returned by httpx.iter_raw before JSON decoding; compressed encodings are retained but rejected for normalization
raw_evidence.header_semantics: raw response header name/value byte pairs in received order, retaining duplicates and original casing, encoded both base64 and latin-1
raw_evidence.json_decoding: strict UTF-8 JSON; duplicate object keys and non-finite constants rejected
raw_evidence.raw_hash: SHA-256 over canonical ordered bindings of resource ordinal, resource name, raw body SHA-256, and raw header-document SHA-256
raw_evidence.normalized_rule_hash: separate SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON of the normalized rules object only

required_independent_venue_fields: event, market, series, condition/question where native, outcome, and token identifiers
exact event title, market title/question, subtitles, and outcome labels
explicit YES/NO polarity mapping with native token or contract-side identifiers
market type, binary/multivariate status, mutually-exclusive and negative-risk flags
opening, closing, expiration, and earliest-resolution timestamps with raw text and normalized UTC
timezone abbreviations appearing in native rules
complete primary, secondary, and additional native rule fields
resolution source text/URLs, settlement authority, and oracle metadata
early-close fields and matching native rule paragraphs
void, cancel, refund, and indeterminate fields and matching native rule paragraphs
created, updated, clarification, and revision timestamps
response evidence references, immutable raw hash, normalized rule hash, explicit missing requirements, and issues

normalization_rules.venue_independence: Never fill one venue's field from the other venue or from PMXT candidate prose.
normalization_rules.missing_native_data: Retain null or an empty collection and list the corresponding explicit missing requirement; never infer.
normalization_rules.timestamps: Retain the exact native value. Normalize only parseable timezone-aware ISO-8601 values to UTC; otherwise normalized_utc remains null.
normalization_rules.yes_no: Kalshi YES and NO contract sides are native outcome identifiers within a market. Polymarket polarity is explicit only when distinct case-insensitive Yes and No labels are present.
normalization_rules.rule_excerpts: Keyword-matched full native paragraphs are diagnostic indexes into retained raw rules, not invented policy.
normalization_rules.settlement_authority: Labels identify the native field and limited claim scope; they do not assert legal or execution equivalence.
normalization_rules.completeness: A venue record is COMPLETE only when every frozen requirement has native coverage and every requested resource response is successful. Otherwise it is PARTIAL.
normalization_rules.pair_decision: Every captured pair remains PENDING_SEMANTIC_REVIEW and live_eligible=false regardless of completeness.

not_allowed: declaring semantic equivalence from capture completeness
